answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 40275 Country: India Title: How to get pure as i m very doubtful about my purity Question: (1) Whenever I wear underwear I get some very tiny drop of stain in it. Sometime it is visible other time not. Am I impure because I do not feel its secretion many times and even when I feel it sometime I find it and sometime not. (2) When I pass urine same thing happens especially when I am offering salah, I feel that something oozed out sometime I do not find any wet area on my cloth. It is from many years what should I do? (3) I have also very dirty habit of masturbation. What should I do to get rid of it as if I do not do I feel uncomfortable. Answer ID: 40275 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1195/776/H=1433) (1) When you feel the spot of drop visible then the underwear and the affected part of the body shall become impure. It is enough to wash the polluted area for purity. And if the spot is not visible then it shall not be termed as impurity. (2) When there is no wetness in the cloth, then it shall not be declared impure. (3) There is no remedy for this except true courage. However, it is the result of each sin that it brings uneasiness and the doer of sin feels temporarily discomfort in giving up the sin. (1) You should do true and genuine taubah. (2) Safeguard your eyes and heart. (3) Consider the fatal consequences of this bad habit and think about the curse and punishment of this world and hereafter. (4) Find out any suitable match and do nikah and pass your life with your wife in good manner. (5) Read these two books extensively (a) Badnazri Ka Elaj (b) Ummul Amraz. (6) Offer salah and recite the holy Quran regularly. (7) Be careful in eating and drinking. (8) Hold fast taqwa in each matter. If you start practicing these things then it is hoped that in-shaAllah, you shall get rid of this bad habit completely and you will hate it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
